message: I am thinking...: We need not necessarily reproduce locally because benchmark has hidden target. Need craft candidate raw input. Based on commit at HEAD, likely sample intended for that commit. Since commit 27fee7f8 adds default instance synthesis, candidate should be variable font with omitted default instance. The non-crash TestAVAR has no instanceCount but maybe no name IDs needed? It didn't trigger; need one with real named instances missing default and name table usable so synthesized entry is created, then selecting synthesized named instance via face_index may hit buggy code. Potential bug: ttobjs.c selects named_style = namedstyle + instance_index - 1; ftfuzzer loops instance_index from 0 to num_instances inclusive? Actually for instance_index=1..num_instances, FT_New_Memory_Face called. For synthesized default last, TT_Set_Var_Design called with named_style->coords. Then TT_Set_MM_Blend loops namedstyles and derefs normalized_stylecoords for synthesized entry. Still read. But also sfnt get_name on synthesized strid/psid could work. TestAVAR has no name? no real instances, but synthesized with names maybe no crash. Need craft font where fvar instanceCount=1, no default, so num_instances=2. Selecting instance 2 might use namedstyle[1].coords. In fixed code coords allocated. In precommit old code allocation based fvar_head.instanceCount only, but style_flags in old precommit was 1 not 2, so no selection. In current buggy code no overflow. If different partial patch: sfnt increments but TT_Get_MM_Var old allocation fvar_head.instanceCount then ttobjs.c allows instance_index 2 and writes named_style[1] maybe OOB write 8 when setting coords pointers? Commit fully changes. But target may be between partially applied? However repo shows full.
